keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Brian Schwake (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Obinna Nwobodo (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card.
Evander (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card.
Samuel Gidi (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Miles Robinson replaces Teenage Hadebe.
Second Half begins FC Cincinnati 0, Nashville SC 0.
Goal! FC Cincinnati 0, Nashville SC 1. Sam Surridge (Nashville SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Andy Nájar with a through ball.
Kyle Smith (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Kenji Mboma Dem replaces Tom Barlow.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Ender Echenique replaces David Doudera.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Shak Mohammed replaces Cristian Espinoza.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Bryan Acosta replaces Matthew Corcoran.
Delay in match because of an injury Jack Maher (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Ayoub Jabbari replaces Kyle Smith.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Alex Muyl replaces Elias Saad.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Josh Bauer replaces Andy Nájar.

Goal! FC Cincinnati 0, Nashville SC 2. Sam Surridge (Nashville SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Patrick Yazbek with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. José Martínez replaces Obinna Nwobodo.
Pavel Bucha (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Nashville SC. Warren Madrigal replaces Hany Mukhtar.
Alex Muyl (Nashville SC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Maxwell Woledzi (Nashville SC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
